title: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI): Federal Occupational Health - Medications, Vaccines, and Medical Supplies (MVMS)
description:
REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI):  Federal Occupational Health – Medications, Vaccines, and Medical Supplies (MVMS)  

 The Government is issuing a Request for Information (RFI) and seeking industry feedback regarding the previous solicitations identified above. 

 The previous solicitation (attached as Draft Solicitation) did not generate the level of industry response and/or proposal quality anticipated by the Government. Accordingly, the Government is interested in engaging with industry to better understand potential factors that may have affected vendor participation and the quality of submissions received. 

 The Government invites interested businesses, including companies that submitted proposals, companies that considered submitting but elected not to participate, and companies that did not previously participate, to (1) participate in a Pre-Solicitation Conference to engage with industry on the requirement and (2) to submit questions to the Draft Solicitation and Pre-Solicitation Conference discussion. 

 The Government is seeking candid feedback to identify potential improvements to the acquisition strategy and future solicitation requirements. 

  Agency:  Department of Health and Human Services 

  Office:  Office of Mission Acquisitions Solutions (OMAS) 

  Previous Solicitation Numbers:  7571MN26R00052 and 7571MN26R00026 

  Requirement Title:  Federal Occupational Health – Medications, Vaccines, and Medical Supplies (MVMS) 

  Notice Type:  RFI – Pre-Solicitation Conference
